ambient_events: A single drip finds the bucket with a flat metallic tap.
description: Number 3B, back corner under the roof. The ceiling slopes where the building's cornice cuts in, low enough to crack your skull if you sit up wrong in the night. A camp bed, a footlocker, a hole in the plaster patched with a road sign. When it rains, the stain on the landing ceiling isn't the only one; you'll hear it here first, tapping the bucket someone thoughtfully left behind.

window.description: One small window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window

name: Unit 4B
